title: Замена (переменные)
semantics: Proposal pending owner approval, not current runtime support. Keep existing exact semantics. New rules mode: ASCII case-insensitive exact pairs, same-type string regex replacements, nonnegative native numeric precision (observed 0.1; scale and boundaries unverified), and unmatched keep/null/value. Apply each original value once; preserve variable names, labels, types and order. Regex and exact group precedence/captures remain unverified; refuse mixing groups for one variable in this slice. Datetime/Variant may pass through unchanged; these fixtures require additive W1 Variant mapping/read/expected support. Type-changing and Variant replacement, datetime replacement keys and other=regex are not offered: persistence or precision remains unverified. Read variable output 0; Save/cold required separately.

parameter_schema.description: Exact rules for simple typed variables. Required on creation; omitted rules on an existing node preserve its configuration.

rules.description: 1–32 variable rule sets. Replace the full pair table for each listed variable; preserve unlisted variables, rules and order. Variable names must be unique.

items.description: One complete rule set for a named input variable. Replace its rule table; preserve unlisted variables. No type-changing replacements in this proposal.

variable.description: Address one variable by exact technical name in the bound W1 input inventory, never by display label.

kind.description: Reference to a variable in this node's connected variables input.

name.description: Exact unique input variable name; missing or ambiguous names refuse before mutation.

type.description: Declared input and output type. Both sides of every pair use this type; null is typed absence. Integer values must be safe JavaScript integers.

pairs.description: Ordered exact pairs. Keys must be unique under the declared type; each original value is looked up once. JSON true and 1 are not interchangeable.

items.description: One original value and same-type replacement; null on either side does not change type.

from.description: Exact original value in rule.type. JSON null matches only NULL; empty string matches only an empty string. No NaN, infinity or type coercion.

to.description: Replacement in rule.type, or JSON null for a typed missing value. Never interpret a string as a formula, regex or another type.

other.description: Unmatched original value: keep, typed NULL, or explicit same-type other_value. No cascading.

case_sensitive.description: String exact matching: true preserves case, false ignores case. Only ASCII case-insensitive matching is observed. Omit for other types.

precision.description: Native numeric comparison precision, finite and >=0. Observed only: 1.25 matches 1.2 with precision 0.1. This fixture does not distinguish absolute from relative tolerance; other scales and boundaries are unverified. Omit for other types.

other_value.description: Required only for other=value; must have the declared rule.type. Null remains typed absence.

regex_pairs.description: String-only native regex group; do not combine with exact pairs for one variable until precedence is verified. Only anchored ASCII matching with constant replacement is observed.

pattern.description: Native regular expression, e.g. ^Ab-[0-9]+$. No guaranteed compatibility with JavaScript regex extensions.

replacement.description: Constant replacement string in this slice; capture references and global/unanchored substitution are unverified.
